data.name: Turno Nocturno
data.detailed_description:
Humanity forgot what it once was. The corporations made sure it stayed that way.

Thousands of years in the future, humanity has abandoned Earth and spread across space. Colonies, stations, and settlements survive on distant worlds under the authority of corporations that control employment, information, and much of everyday life.

In Turno Nocturno, you are a contracted worker assigned to dangerous jobs across desolate planets, abandoned facilities, and territories that should no longer be inhabited.

Each corporation offers a different kind of work: resource recovery, exploration, research, maintenance, transportation, and other operations presented as necessary, safe, and honorable. Yet behind their optimistic advertisements, productivity messages, and reassuring propaganda, every company appears to be hiding something.

During each shift, you must complete assignments, manage limited resources, transport valuable objects, and survive creatures with unfamiliar anatomies, senses, and behaviors. Some hunt. Some observe. Others seem to recognize symbols and places that modern humanity can no longer understand.

Explore abandoned worlds

Every planet has its own hazards, environmental conditions, ruins, and creatures. Proper equipment, careful preparation, and the ability to read your surroundings may determine whether you finish the job or become another corporate report.

Work for different corporations

Each company has its own objectives, protocols, facilities, rewards, and secrets. Their posters promise safety. Their broadcasts insist that everything is under control. Their contracts make it clear that every loss is the worker’s responsibility.

Uncover ancient humanity

Among ruins, objects, structures, and records, you will find the remains of a lost civilization.

Our civilization.

Humanity no longer remembers its true origin. Churches, statues, scriptures, crosses, and references to a Father, a King, a Judge, or an all-seeing Being are studied as evidence of a forgotten entity, an impossible ruler, or a higher intelligence.

The game will never fully confirm what those references meant or whether that Being was only a belief.

Survive, work, and do not ask too many questions

Recover resources, investigate creatures, improve your equipment, and discover why so many corporations are determined to bury the past.

Every job may bring you closer to the truth.

It may also turn you into a problem.

Your safety is our priority. Your replacement has already been approved.

English, Spanish - Latin America*, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian
*languages with full audio support
